MADHAN CHANDRAMOHAN 

MBA – PMP– SAFe Agile – Lean Six Sigma Maser Black Belt

l  Chennai, India l  Phone: +91 9488204666 l  madhanc.scm@gmail.com

Organizational Change & Transformation - with 16 years of global experience driving enterprise-wide adoption, behavior change, and business agility across IT, Pharma, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Logistics. Expert in end-to-end change leadership, stakeholder influence, and designing fit-for-purpose change strategies blending ADKAR, Kotter, Lean Change, and McKinsey 7S.

Known for shaping strategy-to-execution, uplifting capability, and building high-performing cultures through storytelling, data-driven insights, and structured governance. Adept at navigating ambiguity, aligning senior sponsors, and accelerating adoption across global matrix environments.

Skills & Competencies

Organizational Change Management (OCM) | ADKAR | Kotter | Lean Change | McKinsey 7S | Communications Strategy | Leadership Coaching | Sponsor Alignment | Stakeholder Management | Resistance Management | Change Impact & Readiness | Adoption Metrics | Change Saturation | Agile & Lean Ways of Working | Product-Centric Change | Consulting & Advisory | Workshop Design & Facilitation | Capability Uplift | CoP Building | Knowledge Management | Digital Transformation | Process Excellence | BPM | RPA | Industry 4.0 | SAP-ERP Modernization

STRATEGIC & ENTERPRISE TRANSFORMATION

Translated enterprise transformation strategy into clear, actionable project roadmaps, breaking down high-level objectives into sprint-ready deliverables, milestones, and measurable KPIs.

Led the Business Agility Engagement Program, improving delivery efficiency by 25% and strengthening business–IT alignment across global functions.

Re-engineered the Adaptive Delivery Framework (ADF) and increased the adoption by 28%— by clarifying ownership, governance, and scalability.

Ensured GxP and SoX compliance, maintaining audit readiness and operational across transformation initiatives.

OPERATIONAL & PROCESS EXCELLENCE

Drove adoption of Business Process Management (BPM) using Nimbus and Lean methodologies, streamlining 50+ IT and operations processes, and enhancing visibility and governance.

Led and facilitated 100+ Kaizen projects across global operations—achieving up to 25% cycle-time reduction, 15% productivity increase, and stronger cross-functional collaboration.

Directed large-scale Business Process Re-engineering (BPR) and standardization initiatives, reducing operational errors by 20%, cutting process handoffs by 25%, and improving cross-regional system efficiency.

DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION & SOLUTION DELIVERY

Delivered RF Scanner–SAP WM integration at North Ryde, automating warehouse operations with zero disruption during Germany Ramp-Down.

POC for integration of MES system with AWS cloud, server at Singapore.

Led multiple Industry 4.0 POCs, including AR-enabled MES–Pas-X cleaning operations, smart warehouse bin guidance, IoT container tracking, and VR-based operator training.

Led Robotic Process Automation (RPA) initiatives, digitizing processes and reducing FTE by up to 30%.

TEAM FORMATION, RECRUITMENT & CULTURAL TRANSFORMATION

Built and scaled cross-functional project teams across EMEA, APAC, and ANZ, defining roles, responsibilities, and operating models for effective delivery.

Cultivated a global culture of sustainable innovation by empowering 200+ Champions and 40+ transformation leaders to drive ideation across business units—resulting in 400+ innovation ideas that strengthened collaboration, agility, and customer-centric problem solving across the enterprise.

Designed and implemented a governance model to evaluate and scale high-impact ideas to enterprise initiatives, accelerating adoption by 30%, and standardizing best practices across 10+ global sites.

Established role-based Communities of Practice (CoPs) across functions to enable continuous feedback, identify improvement opportunities, and embed a sustainable culture of continuous improvement enterprise-wide.

Professional Experience

AstraZeneca

Senior Manager – Business Agility & Organizational Change                Mar 2021 to Oct 2025  

Led enterprise-wide transformation initiatives spanning business agility, governance, capability development, process excellence, and innovation, driving measurable improvements in delivery efficiency, cross-functional collaboration, and organizational maturity across global functions.

Facilitated alignment workshops with senior sponsors to convert strategic themes into execution backlogs, ensuring clarity of ownership, dependencies, and success metrics.

Designed and rolled out enterprise-wide project delivery standards, templates, and playbooks (ADF, governance models, communication frameworks).

Business Analyst                                                                                        Jan 2018 to Mar 2021   

Led EMEA & APAC supply chain digital transformation and operational excellence initiatives, driving SAP-ERP modernization, RPA automation, Lean-Agile practices. Traveled to Sweden, UK, Germany, Australia, and Bangalore to lead multiple strategic projects and drive cross-regional transformation initiatives.

Olam Global Business Services (OGBS)

Business Analyst Manager			 			         May 2015 to Jan 2018

Led a 20-member global transformation and business analysis team, driving end-to-end supply chain (Seed to Shelf), process re-engineering and standardisation, while traveling to Africa and multiple regions to implement strategic initiatives and enable cross-functional collaboration.

St John Freight Systems

Assistant Manager – International Network Development		         May 2012 to May 2015

Conducted primary market research and drove strategic transformation from 3PL to 4PL, managing end-to-end ideation, planning, and execution while traveling across India and Sri Lanka to support business development initiatives.

Data Sync Solutions Pvt. Ltd

Senior Programmer 				              			Apr 2008 to Jul 2010 

Authored BRDs and FSDs while supporting presales and business development activities for ERP product implementations.

Education:

Master of Business Administration - PSG Institute of Management, Coimbatore – 2010 to 2012

Master of Science - Software Engineering (5yrs Course) – 2003 to 2008

Schooling - Sainik School Amaravathinagar

Awards & Certifications:

Honored with the CII Quality Summit Award for excellence in Lean and Agile Transformation in 2022.

Recognized as Exceptional Contributor (2024) for outstanding leadership in IGNITE for IGNITE transformation.

Executive Leadership Coach (200 +hours) – Deekay Excellence

Lean Portfolio management – SAFe

PMP – Project Management Institute

Six Sigma – Master Black Belt – KPMG

Six Sigma – Black Belt – KPMG 

Six Sigma - Green belt - Indian Statistical Institute, Bangalore

Advanced RPA Professional – Automation Anywhere
